description.en: Evolves a character's Fighting Spirit into a new form, with the jingle J_07 and the message "sysmes-Avatar-00002" (RunEvolutionAvatarUseMsg). The change is made with CMND_AVATAR_EVOLUTION, and the spirit is locked afterwards unless _lock is false.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
true to lock the character's Fighting Spirit afterwards (CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG(hdl, true)); otherwise the lock state it had before is kept.

examples.case: The Fighting Spirit's new form (real usage, from ev44110040.nut)
